info.name: Get aggregated job statistics for scheduled content

params.name: from
params.description: false "Include only jobs with start_time at or after this timestamp (RFC3339)"

params.name: to
params.description: false "Include only jobs with start_time at or before this timestamp (RFC3339)"

items.docs:
Get aggregated job statistics for scheduled content.

Returns total counts of running, waiting, succeeded, and failed scheduled jobs, plus a
time-series histogram of job outcomes bucketed by time.

This endpoint includes **only scheduled jobs**. On-demand executions
(ad-hoc deployments, manual runs) are excluded. This provides statistics
specifically for scheduled content execution.

**Authorization:**

- **Administrators** see statistics for all content system-wide
- **Publishers** see statisti
